issue_context.title: Use collected predicate columns to decide the loading of column statistics
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

After we make collecting predicate columns as a default behavior. We can use the information that it collects to decide which column/index needs its statistics.

This will improve the performance of the loading.

review_comments: The comment will be re-added in next commit.
Can you explain a little bit why this is possible?

Since only stats of predicates will be loaded, only stats of `a` from table `tp` is loaded into memory.
So for the first SQL, the stats of index `ic` and column `b` are not loaded into memory, becoming `unInitialized`. I use a `LoadNeededHistograms` to tell you that the actual stats is correct.
I think we can remove `collectHistNeededColumns` now. And remove the relative comment from other fields as well.
The unneeded stats now is just fully unloaded.
